title: Chapter 229 Forging Progress
content:
Chapter 229 Forging Progress

In the barracks at night, everything is quiet, the only sound is the heavy sound of soldiers patrolling back and forth, wearing iron boots stepping on the ground.

In the coalition barracks, the largest tent covers an area of several acres, and is decorated with gold and jade splendor. All kinds of rare and strange things can be seen everywhere in this tent, which is enough to show the extraordinary status of the owner.

Zhong Yu was sitting on the main seat in his front tent hall, closing his eyes and meditating quietly, listening to the man in black in front of him without moving, and slowly reporting to himself.

"So, after these few days of fighting, my sword is about to complete its initial forging?" Zhong Yu suddenly opened his eyes, and there were a few purple and gold lights in his eyes, frightening endlessly.

"Yes, Your Highness, your divine soldier is about to complete the first stage of forging. You only need to draw the blood of another 300,000 people, and then the second stage of forging will be completed." The dark guard in front of him, one of the few One of the thousands of hidden guards, usually a high-ranking and powerful existence, but in front of Zhong Yu, he was trembling and did not dare to breathe.

"300,000..." Zhong Yu repeated the number of the protagonist in his mouth, but he was thinking about other things.

After a month of decisive battles, the Qin State and the coalition forces have sacrificed more than 300,000 soldiers. Their blood and souls were absorbed from all parts of the battlefield by the formation that had been set up long ago, and gathered in the center of the formation. That long sword.

And the long sword did not live up to his hope. From the beginning, it was only like a piece of iron, and slowly condensed the prototype of a long sword, but it has not been opened yet, and both sides are blunt.

Next, as long as another 300,000 people's blood and souls are drunk, this long sword will begin to strike, and every time it is swung, it will carry an incomparably murderous aura. And because drinking people's essence, blood and soul can defile other people's minds or magic weapons, it is extremely powerful.

"The other two battlefields, how are the small formations arranged? Is it going well?" Zhong Yu asked the leader of the dark guards about the formations in the other two places.

"In the other two battlefields, the formations have been arranged relatively smoothly. Some finished weapons have been refined and are being sent in urgently. It's just that there are no large armies fighting in some places, and a lot of materials were wasted, which is a pity!" Darkly Wei Qianhu said respectfully.

In fact, this time, in addition to the formations arranged on the central battlefield, dozens of small formations were also arranged in the other two places in the north and south, that is, the current positions of the two fronts in the north and south.

It's just that the scale of these formations is small. Compared with the huge formation in the middle that is difficult to see at a glance, the dozens of formations in the other two battlefields only cover a mere kilometer.

And because the scale is small, it is not easy to attract attention, so the dark guards have quietly arranged these dozens of formations without being noticed.

The scale of these formations is small, and the power of the long sword forged is naturally far inferior to that of his own, and the materials used are relatively ordinary. But in the end, it is forged according to the method left by the system, and it will also drink the blood and soul of tens of thousands of soldiers. After forging, the power is also extremely extraordinary.

According to the message given to him before the system disappeared, no matter what kind of magical artifacts in the heavens and myriad worlds, they are generally divided into several levels.

From high to low, it is divided into magic weapon, spirit weapon, magic weapon, and spirit treasure, and there are even higher treasures on it, but Zhong Yu doesn't quite understand why, and the system didn't elaborate.

As for the swords forged by these small formations, as long as they can be completed in a row, it is a top-grade magic weapon, and it is more powerful among the top-grade magic weapons, and has various incredible uses.

As for Zhong Yu's sword, according to his plan, it will attract the blood and souls of millions of people, and then it will be forged with various natural materials and treasures, and various magic circles will be carved on the blade to form it. After that, the power will be earth-shattering.

According to his estimation, the formed weapon is at least a top-grade spiritual weapon, and even a normal one should be a low-grade magic weapon, and the next step-up requires only continuous feeding of more materials and killing enough powerful weapons. The soul of the person can quickly advance.

Zhong Yu attaches great importance to the refining of this batch of weapons. Ever since he was in Feixue Pavilion in the Kingdom of Yan, he watched Zhao Yun, the general under his command, because of the inferiority of the weapons. suffered, and even fell into a disadvantage.

Zhong Yu started this time's weapon refining plan, and continued to collect all kinds of precious materials from all over the country, and even the whole world, and moved them into the entire treasury. Dozens of small formations are for refining these weapons.

His own weapon took a long time to refine. Although it has unlimited potential, the cost is too high. According to his estimation, he may have to finish the battle in the central part of the battlefield before he can completely refine it successfully.

But in the other two places, the weapons trained by those small formations are much easier.

Each of these small formations needs about 5,000 to 30,000 soul blood to form a weapon. And it doesn't take long, just a few days or ten days is enough, very quickly.

So these days, how many people were killed or injured in the two battlefields in the north and the south? In a short period of time, about 33 weapons were refined, and they are currently under the strict protection of the dark guards, and they are urgently transported to Zhong Yu.

These weapons are very precious and powerful, regardless of his potential growth, let's talk about his current rank. They are all high-grade magic weapons, and only a few are middle-grade magic weapons. In the current world, only those weapons ranked on the sword manual can compare.

Moreover, many weapons on the sword manual are only low-grade or middle-grade magic weapons, and there are only a few dozen or so top-grade magic weapons, which are extremely rare.

If those high-flyers in the Jianghu know, they will definitely not let it go easily. For a martial artist, a handy weapon will be their second life, and even look down on their own life.

Zhao Gao's Six Swords Slave is a clear proof. The master swordsman has always controlled the sword and used the sword as a slave, but they are willing to make themselves slaves of the sword for the power of the sword in exchange for powerful strength.

Therefore, for the sake of good weapons, people in the Jianghu would use all means. Zhong Yu never underestimated them.

Therefore, the hidden guards sent had six fourth-tier followers and hundreds of third-tier followers. With this kind of strength, they were already comparable to some of the elementary schools among the Hundred Schools, and they were enough to frighten the young people in the Jianghu.

The hall in front of me has returned to silence, there is no more sound, only the flickering candlelight, bringing some vitality to the silent hall.
